name: aichemist-lizard-band
description: Claude Code mod: flags functions above a cyclomatic-complexity threshold (via lizard, the tool the hotspot skill uses) in your uncommitted changes, in a band above the prompt

ccnThreshold.title: Complexity threshold (CCN)
ccnThreshold.description: Functions with a cyclomatic complexity above this are flagged (lizard's own default is 15)

refreshSeconds.title: Refresh interval (seconds)
refreshSeconds.description: How often the band re-scans your changed files between turns (it also refreshes after every turn)
